content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Bakersfield

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires either a four-year degree with three years of project-management experience, or a high school diploma with five years of experience. Review PMI's full eligibility criteria to confirm you meet the education and hours requirement before enrolling in training.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP Certification Training. Our nationwide cohorts accommodate Bakersfield professionals' schedules. You'll learn the ten knowledge areas, exam domains, and real-world project scenarios from active certified practitioners—all online, on your timeline.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing your 35 contact hours, submit your PMI application with proof of education and project experience. Pay the PMI exam fee directly to PMI. Allow time for PMI to review and approve your application before scheduling your exam.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources, including practice tests and study guides. Schedule your computer-based exam at a local testing center or online. The PMP exam tests your knowledge across five domains; our instructors provide targeted support to build your confidence.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: After earning your PMP, maintain the credential by earning professional development units (PDUs) over a three-year renewal cycle. PDUs come from formal training, volunteering, authoring, or teaching. Renew your credential with PMI before expiration to keep it active in your professional profile.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI sets four eligibility paths based on education: a secondary diploma (high school or equivalent) requires 60 months of project leadership experience; an associate's degree requires 48 months; a bachelor's degree requires 36 months; and a bachelor's or postgraduate degree from a PMI Global Accreditation Center (GAC)-accredited program requires just 24 months. Every path also requires 35 hours of project management education — our course satisfies this requirement in full.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
